verdict.rationale: Bolt supports connecting a GitHub repo to back up projects and 'sync commits automatically' across branches, and can create a new repo from a Bolt project or import an existing one — enabling a workflow where a developer edits locally and pushes via GitHub for Bolt to pick up. However, Bolt itself runs in an in-browser WebContainer (not a local dev environment), so there's no first-class 'local editor + push back' CLI workflow, only git-based sync.
